summary: Iter71 HR Portal full regression. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass — HR login (hrmanager@mascigc.com / HRPortal2026!, must_change_password=false after rotation), /hr/me, /hr/time-verification + .csv (proper CSV content-type), /hr/field-leadership list/detail/PDF (real %PDF body), /hr/employee-accountability (counts+by_kind+fl_records+outstanding_equipment+trainings), /hr/training-records empty state, all HR routes 401 without X-HR-Token, admin token correctly does NOT satisfy /hr scope, Admin /api/admin/hr-users full CRUD lifecycle (list -> create -> reset (custom) -> reset (screen) -> patch -> delete) + 401 without admin token. Frontend: RequireHr guard redirects /hr -> /hr/login, login flow lands on /hr Hub with all 4 data-testid tiles, EnforcePortalScope clears masci.hr.token on navigation to non-/hr URL, sign-out button (data-testid=hr-sign-out) present, /hr/field-leadership renders search+kind filter+records table with View+PDF icon actions, /hr/training-records shows clean 'No training records yet' empty state, /hr/time-verification and /hr/employee-accountability pages render, AdminHRUsersPanel correctly mounted in /admin between Shop Console and Auto-Email Routing with Add User form + Edit/Reset-Password/Delete row actions.

ui_bugs.issue: Tile root <div> with data-testid='hr-tile-time-verification' (and -employee-accountability, -field-leadership, -training-records) is not itself clickable — only the inner 'Open ->' anchor navigates. Users clicking the tile body (card) get no response. Wrap the tile root in an <a> or add an onClick handler so the whole card is a navigation target.

action_items: Optional polish: make HR Hub tile cards fully clickable (wrap tile root in <a> with the same href as the inner 'Open ->' button) so the whole card is the navigation surface — not just the small Open link.
critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py in /app/backend/tests auto-attaches X-Admin-Token to every requests.* call — this makes it impossible to test unauthenticated paths via the requests library. The new iter71 test uses urllib to bypass it. Future test agents should be aware.
Admin /api/admin/hr-users list response shape is {ok, users: [...]} (no 'items' key). Documented for consistency.

/hr/time-verification page body is sparse on first load (text length ~420 chars before data) — confirmed the page renders the title and the Week label, but filters live inside Select components so they don't appear in inner_text. No functional issue, but worth a UX sanity check that filter inputs are visible on first paint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_hr_portal_iter71.py for full HR backend regression (21 tests, ~3.5s). NOTE: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py monkey-patches requests to auto-attach X-Admin-Token. To assert 401 on admin endpoints, use urllib.request as in TestAdminHrUsersCrud.test_admin_endpoints_require_admin_token. HR Hub tiles are non-clickable divs whose 'Open ->' inner link does the navigation — use a more specific selector ([data-testid='hr-tile-X'] >> text=Open) for click flows. Preview URL is the one in /app/frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: HR Hub tile root is rendered as a <div> with the data-testid attribute, but the navigation handler is bound to an inner <a> labeled 'Open ->'. Clicking the card outside that anchor does nothing. Two-line fix: change the tile root from <div> to <Link to=path> (or add an onClick that calls navigate(path) on the wrapper).
